This document outlines the figures that will be generated in the urban phenology project.

# Data and methods

## Supp_Fig.1

Distribution of city samples. The geometry location of selected cities. The size of the circle represents the number of trees in the city/number of species. The PCA location of selected cities. Or some separate figures to show the distribution of characteristics.

```{r fig-spatial}
#| warning: false

inventory_centroids <- readRDS(("~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/summary/inventory_centroids.rds"))
boundary_us <- st_read(("~/lab-data/datasets/boundary/USAdministrative/US/us_boundarydissolve.shp"), quiet = T) |> 
  st_transform(4326)

p_geo <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = boundary_us, fill = "grey85", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = inventory_centroids, aes(size = num_tree, text = site), color = "darkblue", alpha = 0.6) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Number of Trees", range = c(1, 8),labels = label_comma()) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "lon", y = "lat") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey90", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.15)
  )

plotly::ggplotly(p_geo)
```

```{r fig-pca}
#| warning: false
#| include: true
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of cities with tree inventories."
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 7
city_feature <- readRDS("~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/summary/city_feature.rds")

all_city <- readRDS("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/urban/City_list/all_city.rds") |>
  na.omit()
scaled_matrix <- scale(all_city |>
  select(pop_density,bio1, bio12, sd, median)|>
    rename(building_height_sd = sd,
           building_height_median = median)) 
all_city_scaled <- as.data.frame(scaled_matrix)
all_city_scaled$NAME20 <- all_city$NAME20

pca_res <- prcomp(all_city_scaled[, 1:5], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2])
colnames(pca_scores) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
pca_scores$NAME20 <- all_city_scaled$NAME20

pca_loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_res$rotation[, 1:2])
pca_loadings$variable <- rownames(pca_loadings)

arrow_scale <- 5.5
pca_loadings <- pca_loadings |>
  mutate(PC1 = PC1 * arrow_scale,
         PC2 = PC2 * arrow_scale,
         variable = case_when(
    variable == "building_height_sd"     ~ "height_sd",
    variable == "building_height_median" ~ "height_median",
    TRUE ~ variable 
  ))

list_city <- city_feature |>
  st_join(st_read(("~/lab-data/datasets/boundary/USAdministrative/USCities/tl_2024_us_uac20.shp"), quiet = T) |> 
            st_transform(4326) |>
            dplyr::select(NAME20), join = st_nearest_feature) |>
  pull(NAME20)

pca_scores <- pca_scores |>
  mutate(
    selected = NAME20 %in% list_city,
    hover_text = paste("City:", NAME20),
    group = case_when(
      selected ~ "Selected cities",
      TRUE ~ "Other cities"
    )
  )

full_data <- pca_scores |> select(PC1, PC2)
subset_data <- pca_scores |> filter(selected) |> select(PC1, PC2)

density = 0.0001
num_grids = 100
x_breaks <- seq(min(pca_scores$PC1), max(pca_scores$PC1), length.out = num_grids +1)
y_breaks <- seq(min(pca_scores$PC2), max(pca_scores$PC2), length.out = num_grids +1)

df <- pca_scores |>
    mutate(
      x_bin = cut(PC1, breaks = x_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE),
      y_bin = cut(PC2, breaks = y_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE),
      grid_id = paste(x_bin, y_bin, sep = "_")
    )
  
grid_full <- expand.grid(
  x_bin = 1:(length(x_breaks) - 1),
  y_bin = 1:(length(y_breaks) - 1)
) |>
  mutate(
    grid_id = paste(x_bin, y_bin, sep = "_"),
    PC1 = (x_breaks[x_bin] + x_breaks[x_bin + 1]) / 2,
    PC2 = (y_breaks[y_bin] + y_breaks[y_bin + 1]) / 2
  ) |>
  left_join(
    df |>
      group_by(x_bin, y_bin) |>
      summarise(count = n(),
                subset = sum(selected),
                .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("x_bin", "y_bin")
  )

kde_full <- kde(x = full_data, eval.points = grid_full |> select(PC1, PC2))
kde_subset <- kde(x = subset_data, eval.points = grid_full|> select(PC1, PC2))

dens_full <- kde_full$estimate / sum(kde_full$estimate)
dens_subset <- kde_subset$estimate / sum(kde_subset$estimate)

grid_df <- cbind(grid_full,
                 full_density = dens_full,
                 subset_density = dens_subset)

contour_df <- grid_df %>%
  select(PC1, PC2, full_density, subset_density) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(full_density, subset_density),
    names_to = "group", values_to = "density"
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    group == "full_density"   ~ "All cities",
    group == "subset_density" ~ "Selected cities",
    TRUE ~ group
  ))
  
p_pca <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_segment(data = pca_loadings,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")),
               color = "red", size = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = pca_loadings,
            aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = variable),
            color = "red", size = 2.5, hjust = -0.2, vjust = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = filter(pca_scores, !(selected)),
             aes(color = "Other cities"), alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(pca_scores, selected),
             aes(color = "Selected cities"), size = 1) +
  # geom_text(data = filter(pca_scores, selected),
  #           aes(label = NAME20), size = 2, vjust = -1) +
  # geom_text(data = filter(pca_scores,  !selected & GUTI_list),
  #           aes(label = NAME20), size = 2, vjust = -1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "City Category",
    values = c(
      "Other cities" = "grey60",
      "Selected cities" = "darkblue"
    )
  ) +
  new_scale_color() +
    geom_contour(data = contour_df,
                 aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, z = density, color = group),
                 breaks = c(density)) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Density Contour",
      values = c("All cities" = "grey50", "Selected cities" = "cornflowerblue")
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2")+
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.8,
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 15))

p_area <- p_geo + p_pca +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, 
              guides = "collect",
              widths = c(2, 1.2))
ggsave("~/phenology-urban/temp/figure_agu/conus.png", p_area, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 500)
```

### Main_Fig.1 b,d

```{r lmer}
library(lme4)
library(tidytext)
fit_variance_partition <- function(df, species_name) {
  d <- df |> 
    filter(canonicalname == species_name) |>
    mutate(tree_uid = interaction(city, id, drop = TRUE))
  
  if (n_distinct(d$city) < 2 || n_distinct(d$tree_uid) < 10) {
    return(tibble(
      species = species_name,
      sigma_city = NA_real_,
      sigma_within = NA_real_,
      sigma_residual = NA_real_,
      prop_city = NA_real_,
      prop_within = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  model <- tryCatch(
    lmer(doy ~ 1 +  (1 | year) + (1 | city) + (1 | city:id), data = d),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(tibble(
      species = species_name,
      sigma_city = NA_real_,
      sigma_within = NA_real_,
      sigma_residual = NA_real_,
      prop_city = NA_real_,
      prop_within = NA_real_,
      compared_ratio = NA_real_,
      phe_type = phe_type,
      sample_city = n_distinct(d$city)
    ))
  }
  
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
  sigma_city     <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "city"]
  sigma_within  <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "city:id"]
  sigma_residual <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "Residual"]
  sigma_year <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "year"]
  total_var <- sigma_city + sigma_within + sigma_residual + sigma_year
  tibble(
    species = species_name,
    sigma_city = sigma_city,
    sigma_within = sigma_within,
    sigma_residual = sigma_residual,
    prop_city = sigma_city / total_var,
    prop_within = sigma_within / total_var,
    prop_residual = sigma_residual / total_var,
    prop_city2 = prop_city / (sum(prop_city, prop_within)),
    prop_within2 = prop_within / (sum(prop_city, prop_within)),
    phe_type = phe_type,
    sample_city = n_distinct(d$city)
  )
}


################### EOS plot ###################

phe_type = "EOS"
all_city_input <- read_rds(paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/nooutlier_", phe_type, "_input.rds")) |>
  filter(year<2024) |>
  mutate(year = as.factor(year))
species_list <- unique(all_city_input$canonicalname)
variance_partition_all_eos <- map_dfr(
  species_list,
  ~ fit_variance_partition(all_city_input, .x)
)

# variance_partition_all_eos$prop_within2 <- -variance_partition_all_eos$prop_within2
plot_df_eos <- variance_partition_all_eos %>%
  select(species, prop_city2, prop_within2, phe_type, sample_city) %>%
  filter(is.finite(prop_city2), is.finite(prop_within2)) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_city2 = round(prop_city2 * 100, 2),
    prop_within2 = round(prop_within2 * 100, 2),
    group = if_else(prop_city2 < abs(prop_within2),
                    "Within-city > Across-city",
                    "Within-city < Across-city")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(species, levels = unique(species))
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(prop_within2, prop_city2),
    names_to = "component",
    values_to = "prop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    component = recode(component,
                       prop_within2 = "Within-city",
                       prop_city2   = "Across-city")
  )

load("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla/spatial_spde/tree_species.RData")

  mutate(species = gsub("_", " ", species)) %>%
  filter(species %in% phylo_tree$tip.label)

sp_tree <- sort(phylo_tree$tip.label)
keep_sp <- intersect(sp_data, sp_tree)

D2 <- D %>%
  filter(species %in% keep_sp) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(species, levels = keep_sp)
  )
```

### Use sum-of-square to partition variance

```{r sum-of-square}
library(data.table)
dt <- as.data.table(all_city_input )
dt <- dt[, .(canonicalname, city, doy, year)]
dt <- dt[!is.na(doy) & !is.na(city) & !is.na(canonicalname)]

city_stats <- dt[
  ,
  .(
    n_k = .N,
    mean_k = mean(doy),
    ssw_k = sum((doy - mean(doy))^2) 
  ),
  by = .(canonicalname, year, city)
]
sp_overall <- city_stats[
  ,
  .(
    N = sum(n_k),
    K = .N,
    mean_all = sum(n_k * mean_k) / sum(n_k)
  ),
  by = .(canonicalname, year)
]

res_jfisher <- merge(city_stats, sp_overall, by = c("canonicalname", "year")) |>
  mutate(sp_year = paste0(canonicalname, "_", year))

res_jfisher <- res_jfisher[
  ,
  .(
    N = first(N),
    K = first(K),
    SSB = sum(n_k * (mean_k - first(mean_all))^2),
    SSW = sum(ssw_k)
  ),
  by = sp_year
]

res_jfisher[
  ,
  JFisher := fifelse(SSW > 0, SSB / SSW, NA_real_)
]

p_jfisher <- ggplot(res_jfisher |> filter(K > 1), aes(x = SSB, y = SSW)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "grey40", size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Across-city sum of squares (SSB)", 
       y = "Within-city sum of squares (SSW)") +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 100000000), ylim = c(0, 100000000)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggpmisc::stat_poly_eq(
    formula = y ~ x,
    aes(
      label = paste(
        ..p.value.label..
      )
    ),
    parse = TRUE,
    label.x = 0.7,
    label.y = "top"
  ) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, 
              color = "grey80", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggplot(res_jfisher |> filter(K > 1), aes(x = JFisher)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, fill = "grey60", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "J-Fisher's statistic",
       y = "Number of species") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    
  )+ 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    # Font family and general text
    text = element_text(family = "Arial Unicode MS"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
    
    # Panel background and border
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    
    # Grid lines
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "none"
    )
```

### Just phenology variation

Distribution of phenology variation measured by Tukey’s whisker range, with each sample corresponding to a City–Species–Year combination.

```{r}
plot_phe_cities <- function(cities, taxon_col, stats = "sd"){
  pairs <- lapply(c("SOS", "EOS"), function(phe_type) {
    all_city_input <- read_rds(paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/all_", phe_type, "_input.rds"))
    fixed_city <- unique(all_city_input$city) |>
      sort()
    color_palette <- setNames(viridis(length(fixed_city)), fixed_city)
    
    summary_data <- all_city_input %>%
      dplyr::group_by(city, year, .data[[taxon_col]]) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        obs = n(),
        sd = sd(doy, na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR_d = quantile(doy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) - quantile(doy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower_whisker_d = max(quantile(doy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR_d, min(doy, na.rm = TRUE)),
        upper_whisker_d = min(quantile(doy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR_d, max(doy, na.rm = TRUE)),
        whisker_d = upper_whisker_d - lower_whisker_d,
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      mutate(genus = str_extract(.data[[taxon_col]], "^[^ ]+"))
    
    title_text <- if(taxon_col == "canonicalname") {
      "Each sample represents a species–city combination"
    } else {
      "genus"
    }
    
    x_label <- if(stats == "sd") {
      paste0("Standard Deviation of ", phe_type, " (doy)")
    } else if(stats == "IQR_d") {
      paste0("Interquartile range of ", phe_type, " (doy)")
    } else if(stats == "whisker_d") {
      paste0("Tukey whisker range of ", phe_type, " (doy)")
    } else {
      stop("Invalid stats argument. Choose from 'sd', 'IQR_D', or ' whisker_d'.")
    }
    
    binwidth <- if(stats == "sd") {
      2
    } else if(stats == "IQR_d") {
      4
    } else if(stats == "whisker_d") {
      4
    } else {
      stop("Invalid stats argument. Choose from 'sd', 'IQR_D', or ' whisker_d'.")
    }
    
    p_density <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = .data[[stats]], fill = city)) +
      # geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) + 
      labs(x = x_label) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
            title = element_text(size = 14),
            legend.position = "NA")
    
    p_hist <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = .data[[stats]])) +
      geom_histogram(binwidth = binwidth, position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
      # geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
      # scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) + 
      labs(x = x_label) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
            title = element_text(size = 14),
            legend.position = "right")
    list(density = p_density, hist = p_hist)
  })
  
    p_density_all <- wrap_plots(lapply(pairs, `[[`, "density"), ncol = 2) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect")

    p_hist_all <- wrap_plots(lapply(pairs, `[[`, "hist"), ncol = 2)
  
    return(list(city_density = p_density_all, cities_histogram = p_hist_all))
}

tree_dir <- "~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/"
rds_files <- list.files(tree_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
cities <- gsub("\\.rds$", "", basename(rds_files))

# sd, whisker_d, IQR_d
whisker_sp <- plot_phe_cities(cities, "canonicalname", stats = "whisker_d")
whisker_sp$city_density / whisker_sp$cities_histogram +
  plot_annotation(title = "Each sample represents a species–city-year combination")
```

### Phenology variation and temperature variation (one city)

```{r}
source(here("script/spatial_stats_model/prepare_model_input.R"))
city = "Moab"

plot_phe_temp_city <- function(city, taxon_col){
  plots <- lapply(c("SOS", "EOS"), function(phe_type) {
    model_input_all <- prepare_data(city, source = "Grid", taxa_col= taxon_col, phe_type = phe_type)
    fixed_taxa <- unique(model_input_all[[taxon_col]]) |>
      sort()
    color_palette <- setNames(viridis(length(fixed_taxa)), fixed_taxa)
    temp_col = grep("^temp", names(model_input_all), value = TRUE)
    doy_temp_summary <- model_input_all %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data[[taxon_col]]) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        median_doy = median(doy, na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR_d = quantile(doy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) - quantile(doy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower_whisker_d = max(quantile(doy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR_d, min(doy, na.rm = TRUE)),
        upper_whisker_d = min(quantile(doy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR_d, max(doy, na.rm = TRUE)),
        median_temp = median(.data[[temp_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR_t = quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) - quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower_whisker_t = max(quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR_t, min(.data[[temp_col]], na.rm = TRUE)),
        upper_whisker_t = min(quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR_t, max(.data[[temp_col]], na.rm = TRUE)),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    title_text <- if(taxon_col == "canonicalname") {
      "Species"
    } else {
      "Genus"
    }
    ggplot(doy_temp_summary, aes(x = median_temp, y = median_doy, color = .data[[taxon_col]])) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_whisker_d, ymax = upper_whisker_d), width = 0.2, linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower_whisker_t, xmax = upper_whisker_t), height = 4, linewidth = 1,  alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) + 
      labs(x = temp_col, y = phe_type, title = title_text) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
            title = element_text(size = 14),
            legend.position = "none")
    })
  
  plot <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2)
  return(plot)
}

p <- plot_phe_temp_city(city, "genus") / plot_phe_temp_city(city, taxon_col=  "canonicalname") +
  plot_annotation(title = paste0("Phenology variation across species in ",city))
```

### Phenology variation plus temperature variation (across cities)

```{r}
tree_dir <- "~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/"
rds_files <- list.files(tree_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
cities <- gsub("\\.rds$", "", basename(rds_files))

source(here("script/spatial_stats_model/prepare_model_input.R"))
set.seed(123)
color_palette <- setNames(
  randomcoloR::distinctColorPalette(length(cities)),
  cities |> sort()
)

plot_phe_temp_cities <- function(cities, taxon_col, color_col = "city"){
  plots <- lapply(c("SOS", "EOS"), function(phe_type) {
    all_city_input <- data.frame()
    for (city in cities){
      model_input_all <- prepare_data(city, source = "Grid", taxa_col = taxon_col, phe_type = phe_type)
      phe_metric <- "doy"
      clean_model_input_all <- model_input_all |>
        filter(year < 2024) |>
        group_by(canonicalname) |>
        summarise(
          q1 = quantile(.data[[phe_metric]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
          q3 = quantile(.data[[phe_metric]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
          iqr = q3 - q1,
          lo = q1 - 1.5 * iqr,
          hi = q3 + 1.5 * iqr,
          .groups = "drop"
        ) |>
        right_join(
          model_input_all |> filter(year < 2024),
          by = "canonicalname"
        ) |>
        filter(
          is.na(.data[[phe_metric]]) |
            dplyr::between(.data[[phe_metric]], lo, hi)
        ) |>
        mutate(city = city) |>
        select(-q1, -q3, -iqr, -lo, -hi)
      all_city_input <- rbind(all_city_input, clean_model_input_all)
    }
    
    temp_col = grep("^temp", names(all_city_input), value = TRUE)
    doy_temp_summary <- all_city_input %>%
      dplyr::group_by(city, canonicalname) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        obs = n(),
        median_doy = median(doy, na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR_d = quantile(doy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) - quantile(doy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q25_d = quantile(doy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q75_d = quantile(doy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower_whisker_d = max(quantile(doy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR_d, min(doy, na.rm = TRUE)),
        upper_whisker_d = min(quantile(doy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR_d, max(doy, na.rm = TRUE)),
        median_temp = median(.data[[temp_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR_t = quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) - quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q25_t = quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q75_t = quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower_whisker_t = max(quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR_t, min(.data[[temp_col]], na.rm = TRUE)),
        upper_whisker_t = min(quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR_t, max(.data[[temp_col]], na.rm = TRUE)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) 
    
    title_text <- if(phe_type == "SOS") {
      "Mean winter temperature (°C)"
    } else {
      "Mean summer temperature (°C)"
    }
    phy_type_label <- if(phe_type == "SOS") {
      "Start-of-season (DOY)"
    } else {
      "End-of-season (DOY)"
    }
    
    ggplot(doy_temp_summary, aes(x = median_temp, y = median_doy)) +
      geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = q25_d, ymax = q75_d), width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.05, color = "grey30") +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = q25_t, xmax = q75_t), width = 1, linewidth = 0.3,  alpha = 0.05, color = "grey30") +
      # scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) + 
      labs(x = title_text, y = phy_type_label) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 365)) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
            title = element_text(size = 18),
            legend.position = "none")
    })
  
  plot <- (wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect"))
  return(plot)
}

p <- plot_phe_temp_cities(cities, taxon_col = "canonicalname", color_col = "city")
p
ggsave("~/phenology-urban/temp/figure_agu/phenology_temperature_cities2.png", p, width = 10, height = 4.5, dpi = 500)
```

### City example

```{r}
#| include: false
# Helper to process files by pattern

generate_mcmc_plot <- function(dir_path, coef, fixed_sp){
  process_files <- function(file_list, phe_type_label) {
    param_list <- purrr::map(file_list, function(file) {
    model_data <- readRDS(file)
    genus <- sub(paste0("(.*?)_", phe_type_label, "\\.rds"), "\\1", basename(file))
    ggmcmc::ggs(model_data$samples) |>
      dplyr::filter(stringr::str_starts(Parameter, stringr::fixed(coef))) |>
      dplyr::rename(ParameterOriginal = Parameter) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Parameter = genus,
        converge  = model_data$converge
        # waic = model_data$WAIC$WAIC,
        # milk = model_data$mean_logml
      )
    })
    combined_param_data <- bind_rows(param_list) |>
      mutate(phe_type = phe_type_label)
    return(combined_param_data)
}
  # Collect files
  SOS_files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "SOS\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
  EOS_files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "EOS\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

  # Process each type
  if (length(SOS_files) == 0) {
    sos_data <- NULL
  } else {
  sos_data <- process_files(SOS_files, "SOS")
  }
  if (length(EOS_files) == 0) {
    eos_data <- NULL
  } else {
    eos_data <- process_files(EOS_files, "EOS")
  }

  combined_param_data <- bind_rows(sos_data, eos_data)
  combined_param_data$phe_type <- factor(combined_param_data$phe_type, levels = c("SOS", "EOS"))

  # Summarize
  summary_data <- combined_param_data |>
    group_by(Parameter, phe_type) |>
    summarise(
      median_value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      lower_2_5 = quantile(value, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      upper_97_5 = quantile(value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      converge = first(converge),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(Sig = ifelse(lower_2_5 * upper_97_5 > 0, "*", ""),
           SigAlpha = ifelse(Sig == "*", 1, 0.2),
           Color = ifelse(median_value >0, "#0D0887FF" , "#FCA636FF")) 

  param_levels <- rev(unique(summary_data$Parameter))
  
  summary_data <- summary_data %>% 
    mutate(
      phe_type = paste0("beta[Temp]~' for '~", phe_type),
      phe_type = factor(phe_type, 
                        levels = c("beta[Temp]~' for '~SOS", 
                                   "beta[Temp]~' for '~EOS"))
    )

  # Plot
  
  p1 <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = factor(as.character(Parameter), levels = param_levels), y = median_value,
                                 colour = Color)) +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = SigAlpha), size=3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_2_5, ymax = upper_97_5, alpha = SigAlpha), width = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(median_value, 3)),
              vjust = -0.7, size = 3) +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    scale_color_identity() +
    guides(alpha = "none") +
    facet_grid( ~ phe_type,
             scales = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(phe_type = label_parsed)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Estimate") +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14)
    ) +
      coord_flip()
  
  p2 <- ggplot(combined_param_data, aes(x = value)) +
    geom_density(fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ Parameter, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = paste0("Posterior distribution of ", coef),
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    facet_grid(Parameter ~ phe_type, scales = "free_y")+
    # geom_text(data = summary_data, aes(x = median_value-3, y = 0, label = round(median_value, 3)), vjust = -1, size = 3) +
    geom_text(data = summary_data, aes(x = median_value+3, y = 0, label = paste0("gelman.diag: ", round(converge, 4))), vjust = -1, color = "red", size = 2) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "lines")
    )
  
  p <- list(coef_summary_plot = p1, coef_density_plot = p2, summary_data = summary_data)
  return(p)
}

mcmc_semi_matern <- function(r_output_dir, phe_type) {
  plots_mean <- list()
  plots_semi <- list()
  # Load the data
  r_files <- list.files(r_output_dir, pattern = paste0(phe_type, "\\.rds$"), full.names = TRUE)
  for (file in r_files) {
    model_data <- readRDS(file)
    taxon <- sub(paste0("(.*?)_", phe_type, "\\.rds"), "\\1", basename(file))
    surf_sf <- model_data$surf_sf
    CorDF <- model_data$CorDF
    r <- raster(extent(surf_sf), resolution = 1000)
    raster_field <- rasterize(surf_sf, r, field = "w_mean")
    raster_df <- as.data.frame(raster_field, xy = TRUE)
    plot_spatial_field <- ggplot(raster_df) +
      geom_raster(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = layer)) +
      scale_fill_viridis(na.value = "transparent") +
      coord_fixed(ratio = 0.8) +
      ggtitle(paste(taxon)) +
      labs(fill = "E[w|data]") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            plot.title = element_text(size = 8))
        
    plot_cor <- ggplot(CorDF, aes(x = Distance, y = Median)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), fill = "grey", alpha = 0.4) +
      geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
      labs(x = "Distance (m)", y = "Correlation", title = "Matern Correlation Function") +
      ggtitle(paste(taxon)) +
      theme_minimal()+
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            plot.title = element_text(size = 8))
        
    plots_mean[[taxon]] <- plot_spatial_field
    plots_semi[[taxon]] <- plot_cor
  }
  combined_plot_mean <- wrap_plots(plots_mean, ncol = 5)
  combined_plot_semi <- wrap_plots(plots_semi, ncol = 5)
  
   return(list(
    combined_plot_semi = combined_plot_semi,
    combined_plot_mean = combined_plot_mean
  ))
}

plot_coef_sp_city <- function(r_output_dir){
  coef_summary <- data.frame()
  coef_summary <- map_dfr(
      phe_types,
      ~ read_rds(paste0(r_output_dir, .x, "_summary.rds")) %>%
          mutate(phe_type = .x)
    )
  coef_summary$Factor2 <- factor(coef_summary$Factor,
                               levels = unique(coef_summary$Factor))
  coef_summary$phe_type <- factor(coef_summary$phe_type,
                                levels = c("SOS", "EOS"))
  p_coef <-  ggplot(coef_summary, aes(x = Factor2, 
                               y = Estimate,
                               color = Color
                               )) +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = SigAlpha, color = Color), position = position_dodge(w = 0.5), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, alpha = SigAlpha, color = Color), 
                  position = position_dodge(w = 0.5), 
                  width = 0.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    labs(x = "Species", y = bquote(beta[Temp]~" estimate")) + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, hjust = 1, size = 8, face = "italic"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14)) +
    # coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ phe_type, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    scale_color_identity() +
    # geom_text(aes(label = Sig, y = Upper + 0.05  ), hjust = -0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    # geom_text(aes(label = Estimate, y = Estimate  ), vjust = -0.7, show.legend = FALSE, size = 3) +
    guides(alpha = "none")
  
  return(p_coef)
}
```

## Frequentist result


```{r}
plot_coef_sp_city <- function(r_output_dir, level = "Factor", phe_types){
  coef_summary <- data.frame()
  coef_summary <- map_dfr(
      phe_types,
      ~ read_rds(paste0(r_output_dir, .x, "_summary.rds")) %>%
          mutate(phe_type = .x)
    )
  
  load("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla/spatial_spde/tree_species.RData") # phylo_tree
  class_tree <- phylo_tree
  df_filtered <- coef_summary %>%
      filter(.data[[level]] %in% class_tree$tip.label)
  class_used   <- unique(df_filtered[[level]])
  tree_sub  <- drop.tip(class_tree,
                        setdiff(class_tree$tip.label, class_used))
  class_order <- tree_sub$tip.label 
  
  coef_df_plot <- df_filtered |>
    mutate(
      !!level := factor(.data[[level]], levels = rev(class_order))
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Color = case_when(
        is.na(Color) ~ "grey95",
        TRUE ~ Color
      ),
      SigAlpha = case_when(
        is.na(SigAlpha) ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ SigAlpha
      ),
      !!level := factor(.data[[level]], levels = rev(class_order))
    )
  coef_df_plot$phe_type <- factor(coef_df_plot$phe_type,
                                levels = c("SOS", "EOS"))
  p_coef <-  ggplot(coef_df_plot, aes(x = Factor, 
                               y = Estimate,
                               color = Color
                               )) +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = SigAlpha, color = Color), position = position_dodge(w = 0.5), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, alpha = SigAlpha, color = Color), 
                  position = position_dodge(w = 0.5), 
                  width = 0.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    labs(x = "Species", y = bquote(beta[Temp]~" estimate")) + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text = element_blank()) +
    # coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ phe_type, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    scale_color_identity() +
    # geom_text(aes(label = Sig, y = Upper + 0.05  ), hjust = -0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    # geom_text(aes(label = Estimate, y = Estimate  ), vjust = -0.7, show.legend = FALSE, size = 3) +
    guides(alpha = "none")
  
  tree_plot <- ggtree(tree_sub) +
    layout_dendrogram()
  
  p_combined <- tree_plot / p_coef +
    plot_layout(heights = c(2, 20))
  
  return(p_combined)
}
```

```{r input-heatmap}
#| include: false
### Group by city and phe_type
tree_dir <- "~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_NPN/"
rds_files <- list.files(tree_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
cities <- gsub("\\.rds$", "", basename(rds_files))
phe_types <- c("SOS", "EOS")

coef_summary_all <- data.frame()
for (city in cities) {
  r_output_dir <- paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla_NPN/spatial_spde//", city, "/canonicalname/")
  for (phe_type in phe_types) {
    file_path <- file.path(r_output_dir, paste0(phe_type, "_summary.rds"))
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      coef_summary <- readr::read_rds(file_path) |>
        dplyr::mutate(phe_type = phe_type, city = city)
      coef_summary_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(coef_summary_all, coef_summary)
    }
  }
}

coef_summary_all <- coef_summary_all |> 
  # filter(city != "Rochester") |>
  mutate(phe_type = factor(phe_type, levels = phe_types),
         genus = sub(" .*", "", Factor),
         species = Factor) |>
  left_join(
    readr::read_rds("~/phenology-urban/temp/tree_genus_family.rds"),
    by = "genus") |>
  mutate(city_label = unname(city_label[city]))

city_feature <- readRDS("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/summary/city_feature.rds") |>
  select(-bio1, -bio12) |>
  left_join(read_rds("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/summary/city_bioclimate.rds") |>
              select(site, bio1, bio12), by = "site") |>
  rename(city = site) |>
  mutate(city = ifelse(city == "St_George", "StGeorge", city)) |>

city_inven_backbone <- read_rds("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla/spatial_spde/city_inven_backbone.rds")

city_inven_backbone_filtered <- city_inven_backbone |>
  filter(
    kingdom == "Plantae", phylum == "Tracheophyta",
    rank %in% c("GENUS", "SPECIES"),
    status %in% c("ACCEPTED", "SYNONYM")
  )

city_inven_backbone_filtered_consolidated <- city_inven_backbone_filtered |>
  mutate(usageKey = if_else(status == "SYNONYM", acceptedUsageKey, usageKey))

overlap_city_species_range <- coef_summary_all |>
  mutate(Factor := gsub("_", " ", species)) |>
  left_join(city_inven_backbone_filtered_consolidated |>
              select(usageKey, verbatim_name), by = c("Factor" = "verbatim_name")) |>
  left_join(read_rds("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/tree_origin/chelsa/sp_chelsa_summary.rds"),
            by = c("usageKey" = "specieskey")) |>
  left_join(city_feature |> 
              select(-city_label) |>
              st_drop_geometry(), 
            by = "city")

overlap_city_species_range_model <- overlap_city_species_range |>
  mutate(hot_edge = bio1 - bio1_p95,
         cold_edge = bio1_p5 - bio1,
         d_temp = bio1 - bio1_median,
         d_prcp = bio12 - bio12_median,
         temp_breadth = bio1_p95 - bio1_p5,
         prcp_breadth = bio12_p95 - bio12_p5,
         dry_edge = bio12 - bio12_p5)  |>
  select(-bio1, -bio12)# larger value: further away from the edge
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    species_label = if_else(
      str_detect(species_name, " "),
      str_replace(species_name, "^([A-Za-z])[A-Za-z]+\\s+([A-Za-z-]+).*$", "\\1. \\2"),
      species_name
    ),
    species_label_plotmath = paste0("italic('", species_label, "')"),
    label_plotmath = if_else(species_name %in% sos_target_species, species_label_plotmath, "")
  )

plot_sos <- ggplot(plot_sos_df, aes(x = mean_abs, y = bio1_slope, size = size)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = sig)) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = plot_sos_df,
    aes(label = label_plotmath),
    parse = TRUE,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.25,
    point.padding = 0.15,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.color = NA,
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = expression("Mean SOS sensitivity (" * "|" * beta[Temp] * "|, days " * degree * plain(C)^-1 * ")"),
    y = expression("bio1 constraint (" * lambda[1*","*m] * ", days " * degree * plain(C)^-1 * degree * plain(C)^-1 * ")")
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(name = "Significance", 
  values = c("ns" = 0.1, "*" = 0.4)) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "# Planted cities",
    range = c(1, 9),
    limits = c(10, 50),
    breaks = c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50),
    labels = c("10", "20", "30", "40", "50")
  ) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  theme_set(
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside"
      )
)
```

## Connection to GSL

### input data

```{r input-heatmap}
#| include: false
### Group by city and phe_type
tree_dir <- "~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/"
rds_files <- list.files(tree_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
cities <- gsub("\\.rds$", "", basename(rds_files))

phe_types <- c("SOS", "EOS")
coef_summary_all <- data.frame()
for (city in cities) {
  r_output_dir <- paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla/spatial_spde/", city, "/canonicalname/")
  for (phe_type in phe_types) {
    file_path <- file.path(r_output_dir, paste0(phe_type, "_summary.rds"))
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      coef_summary <- readr::read_rds(file_path) |>
        dplyr::mutate(phe_type = phe_type, city = city)
      coef_summary_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(coef_summary_all, coef_summary)
    }
  }
}

phe_types <- c("GSL_winter", "GSL_summer")
coef_summary_all_end <- data.frame()
for (city in cities) {
  r_output_dir <- paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla_gsl/spatial_spde/", city, "/canonicalname/")
  for (phe_type in phe_types) {
    file_path <- file.path(r_output_dir, paste0(phe_type, "_summary.rds"))
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      coef_summary <- readr::read_rds(file_path) |>
        dplyr::mutate(phe_type = phe_type, city = city)
      coef_summary_all_end <- dplyr::bind_rows(coef_summary_all_end, coef_summary)
    }
  }
}

match_coef <- coef_summary_all |>
  select(Factor, city, phe_type, Estimate, Sig, Color) |>
  left_join(coef_summary_all_end |>
              mutate(gsl_type = case_when(
                phe_type == "GSL_winter" ~ "SOS",
                phe_type == "GSL_summer" ~ "EOS"
              )) |>
              select(Factor, city, gsl_type, gsl_sig = Sig, gsl_color = Color, gsl_coef = Estimate)
            , by = c("Factor", "city", "phe_type" = "gsl_type"))

SOS_GSL_df <- match_coef |>
  filter(phe_type == "SOS") |>
  group_by(Color) |>
  summarise(
    mean_GSL_coef = mean(gsl_coef, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_SOS_GSL <- ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(data = match_coef |> filter(phe_type == "SOS"),
                 aes(x = gsl_coef, group = Color,  fill = Color), position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, bins = 100) +
  geom_vline(data = SOS_GSL_df, 
             aes(xintercept = mean_GSL_coef, color = Color), size = 1) +
  geom_text(data = SOS_GSL_df, 
            aes(x = mean_GSL_coef, y = 70, label = round(mean_GSL_coef, 2), color = Color,
                hjust = if_else(mean_GSL_coef > 0, -0.5, 1.5)), size = 10) +
  labs(x = bquote("GSL-winter" ~ beta[T]), y = "Count") +
  scale_fill_identity(
    breaks = c("#0D0887FF", "#FCA636FF"),
    name = NULL,
    labels = c(
      expression("SOS–winter"~ beta[T] > 0),
      expression("SOS–winter"~ beta[T] < 0)
    ),
    guide = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(alpha = 0.5)
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-8, 8)) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 22),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 17),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 5, l = 0),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  )

EOS_GSL_df <- match_coef |>
  filter(phe_type == "EOS") |>
  group_by(Color) |>
  summarise(
    mean_GSL_coef = mean(gsl_coef, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_EOS_GSL <- ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(data = match_coef |> filter(phe_type == "EOS"),
                 aes(x = gsl_coef, group = Color,  fill = Color), position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, bins = 100) +
  geom_vline(data = EOS_GSL_df, 
             aes(xintercept = mean_GSL_coef, color = Color), size = 1) +
  geom_text(data = EOS_GSL_df, 
            aes(x = mean_GSL_coef, y = 70, label = round(mean_GSL_coef, 2), color = Color,
                hjust = if_else(mean_GSL_coef > 0, -0.5, 1.2)), size = 10) +
  labs(x = bquote("GSL-summer" ~ beta[T]), y = "Count") +
  scale_fill_identity(
    breaks = c("#0D0887FF", "#FCA636FF"),
    name = NULL,
    labels = c(
      expression("EOS–summer"~ beta[T] > 0),
      expression("EOS–summer"~ beta[T] < 0)
    ),
    guide = guide_legend(

      byrow = TRUE,

  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-16, 16)) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 22),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 17),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 5, l = 0),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  )
```
